name: CDC BRFSS state prevalence, 2023 (2022 for dental visits)
publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
source_dataset_name: Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) Prevalence Data (2011 to present)
source_release_id: BRFSS Prevalence Data (2011 to present): 2023 and 2022 crude prevalence, Overall
uncertainty: 95% confidence interval as published by CDC. Sample size is the number of respondents giving the published response.
limitations: State survey estimates from telephone interviews with adults; they are self-reported and weighted by CDC.
A BRFSS state estimate is a direct survey result. A PLACES county or tract estimate is modeled from the same survey. A state figure shown beside a county figure is context, not a ranking benchmark.
Crude prevalence, not age-adjusted: states with older populations tend to show higher rates of chronic conditions.
Kentucky and Pennsylvania have no 2023 result in this CDC file and are shown as not published for 2023 measures.
The "All States and DC (median)" figure is the middle state value, not a national estimate, and has no confidence interval.
The insurance measure covers adults aged 18 to 64 and is not comparable with the Census all-ages uninsured share.
Values are as published by CDC. CHIP does not derive a state value from counties or combine responses.

measures.label: Diagnosed diabetes
measures.source_question: Have you ever been told by a doctor that you have diabetes?
measures.official_definition: Have you ever been told by a doctor that you have diabetes? Response published: Yes.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report that a doctor told them they have diabetes. Diabetes only during pregnancy and pre-diabetes are separate responses and are not counted.

measures.label: High blood pressure
measures.source_question: Adults who have been told they have high blood pressure (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions)
measures.official_definition: Adults who have been told they have high blood pressure (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions) Response published: Yes.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report being told by a health professional that they have high blood pressure.

measures.label: Obesity
measures.source_question: Weight classification by Body Mass Index (BMI) (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions)
measures.official_definition: Weight classification by Body Mass Index (BMI) (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions) Response published: Obese (BMI 30.0 - 99.8).
measures.interpretation: Adults whose body mass index, calculated from self-reported height and weight, is 30 or higher.

measures.label: Coronary heart disease
measures.source_question: Ever told you had angina or coronary heart disease?
measures.official_definition: Ever told you had angina or coronary heart disease? Response published: Yes.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report being told they had angina or coronary heart disease.

measures.label: Stroke
measures.source_question: Ever told you had a stroke?
measures.official_definition: Ever told you had a stroke? Response published: Yes.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report being told they had a stroke.

measures.label: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
measures.source_question: Ever told you have COPD?
measures.official_definition: Ever told you have COPD? Response published: Yes.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report being told they have COPD, emphysema, or chronic bronchitis.

measures.label: Current asthma
measures.source_question: Adults who have been told they currently have asthma (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions)
measures.official_definition: Adults who have been told they currently have asthma (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions) Response published: Yes.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report being told they have asthma and that they still have it.

measures.label: Depression
measures.source_question: Ever told you that you have a form of depression?
measures.official_definition: Ever told you that you have a form of depression? Response published: Yes.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report being told they have a form of depression.

measures.label: Frequent mental distress
measures.response: 14+ days when mental health not good
measures.source_question: Days when mental health status not good (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions)
measures.official_definition: Days when mental health status not good (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions) Response published: 14+ days when mental health not good.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report 14 or more days in the past 30 when their mental health was not good.

measures.label: Current cigarette smoking
measures.source_question: Adults who are current smokers (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions)
measures.official_definition: Adults who are current smokers (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions) Response published: Yes.
measures.interpretation: Adults who have smoked at least 100 cigarettes and now smoke every day or some days.

measures.label: Routine checkup within the past year
measures.source_question: About how long has it been since you last visited a doctor for a routine checkup?
measures.official_definition: About how long has it been since you last visited a doctor for a routine checkup? Response published: Within the past year.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report visiting a doctor for a routine checkup within the past year.

measures.label: Current lack of health insurance
measures.response: Do not have some form of health insurance
measures.source_question: Adults aged 18-64 who have any kind of health care coverage (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions)
measures.official_definition: Adults aged 18-64 who have any kind of health care coverage (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions) Response published: Do not have some form of health insurance.
measures.interpretation: Adults aged 18 to 64 who report having no form of health care coverage.

measures.label: Visited dentist or dental clinic in the past year
measures.source_question: Visited the dentist or dental clinic within the past year for any reason (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions)
measures.official_definition: Visited the dentist or dental clinic within the past year for any reason (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions) Response published: Yes.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report visiting a dentist or dental clinic for any reason within the past year.

measures.label: Binge drinking
measures.source_question: Binge drinkers (males having five or more drinks on one occasion, females having four or more drinks on one occasion) (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions)
measures.official_definition: Binge drinkers (males having five or more drinks on one occasion, females having four or more drinks on one occasion) (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions) Response published: Yes.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report five or more drinks (men) or four or more drinks (women) on one occasion in the past 30 days.

measures.label: No leisure-time physical activity
measures.source_question: During the past month, did you participate in any physical activities? (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions)
measures.official_definition: During the past month, did you participate in any physical activities? (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions) Response published: No.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report no physical activity or exercise outside their regular job in the past month.

measures.label: Fair or poor self-rated health
measures.source_question: Health Status (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions)
measures.official_definition: Health Status (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions) Response published: Fair or Poor Health.
measures.interpretation: Adults who rate their general health as fair or poor.

measures.label: Frequent physical distress
measures.response: 14+ days when physical health not good
measures.source_question: Days when physical health status not good (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions)
measures.official_definition: Days when physical health status not good (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions) Response published: 14+ days when physical health not good.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report 14 or more days in the past 30 when their physical health was not good.

measures.label: Arthritis
measures.source_question: Adults who have been told they have arthritis (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions)
measures.official_definition: Adults who have been told they have arthritis (variable calculated from one or more BRFSS questions) Response published: Yes.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report being told they have some form of arthritis.

measures.label: Kidney disease
measures.source_question: Ever told you have kidney disease?
measures.official_definition: Ever told you have kidney disease? Response published: Yes.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report being told they have kidney disease, not including kidney stones, bladder infection, or incontinence.

measures.label: Could not see a doctor because of cost
measures.source_question: Was there a time in the past 12 months when you needed to see a doctor but could not because you could not afford it?
measures.official_definition: Was there a time in the past 12 months when you needed to see a doctor but could not because you could not afford it? Response published: Yes.
measures.interpretation: Adults who report a time in the past 12 months when they needed to see a doctor but could not because they could not afford it.
